name: HRC_SEM_JOB_LOCS
description: This table is to store the job locations.

columns.name: JOB_LOC_ID
columns.description: This is the primary key of the job location table.

columns.name: JOB_ID
columns.description: This column contains the Job ID referenced to the Job table.

columns.name: COUNTRY_ID
columns.description: This is the country id of the address.

columns.name: STATE_ID
columns.description: This is the state id of the address.

columns.name: CITY_ID
columns.description: This is the city id of the address.

columns.name: FQN
columns.description: This column indicates the fully qualified name of the location.

columns.name: LATITUDE
columns.description: This is the lattitude of the location.

columns.name: LONGITUDE
columns.description: This is the longitude of the location.

columns.name: IS_ERROR
columns.description: This column indicates if there is an error in indexing event.

columns.name: ERROR_MESSAGE
columns.description: This column contains the error message of the indexing event.

columns.name: CREATED_BY
columns.description: Who column: indicates the user who created the row.

columns.name: CREATION_DATE
columns.description: Who column: indicates the date and time of the creation of the row.

columns.name: LAST_UPDATED_BY
columns.description: Who column: indicates the user who last updated the row.

columns.name: LAST_UPDATE_DATE
columns.description: Who column: indicates the date and time of the last update of the row.

columns.name: LAST_UPDATE_LOGIN
columns.description: Who column: indicates the session login associated to the user who last updated the row.

columns.name: OBJECT_VERSION_NUMBER
columns.description: Used to implement optimistic locking. This number is incremented every time that the row is updated. The number is compared at the start and end of a transaction to detect whether another session has updated the row since it was queried.
